root_cause_verification.rationale: Root cause 1 (hardcoded push origin main) was already fixed in commit 41e4544 and confirmed absent by grep scan. Root cause 2 (git commit exits with code 1 on nothing-to-commit under set -euo pipefail) is directly addressed by the new conditional at line 529. The guard checks 'git diff --cached --quiet' before attempting the commit, which is the correct technique: exits 0 when the index is clean (skip commit), exits 1 when changes exist (proceed to commit). This prevents set -euo pipefail from killing the script on idempotent redeploy.
